scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R public/. dist/ && cp index.html dist/ && cp src/style.css dist/ && bun build src/main.js --outfile dist/main.js --minify --target browser && V=$(date +%s) && sed -i "" -e "s/\"main\.js\"/\"main.js?v=$V\"/" -e "s/\"style\.css\"/\"style.css?v=$V\"/" dist/index.html
